recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD56 對 CD57 四象限流式圖：CD57+CD56+ 占 41.22%，綠色 NK 細胞緊密成團、CD57 強而 CD56 僅弱到中度；CD56 並非強陽性，較符合成熟 NK 細胞的慢性增生。
features: Quadrant dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD56-APC (x) versus CD57-FITC (y)
CD57+CD56+ quadrant 41.22%, dominated by a tight green NK-cell cluster
NK cluster CD57 bright (~10^1.5 to 10^2) with dim-to-moderate CD56 (not CD56 bright)
CD57-CD56- quadrant ~48% (T and B cells), CD57+CD56- 6.43%, CD57-CD56+ 4.34%
Uniform phenotype of the expanded cluster suggests a restricted mature NK subset
describe_en: Flow cytometric quadrant plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD56 versus CD57. CD56-positive, CD57-positive cells account for 41.22% of lymphocytes and form a tight cluster with bright CD57 and dim-to-moderate CD56, while CD56-positive CD57-negative cells are only 4.34%. The homogeneous CD56-dim, CD57-bright phenotype corresponds to mature cytotoxic NK cells rather than CD56-bright immature NK cells. Findings are consistent with the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: ANKL cells are typically CD56 bright and CD57 negative, unlike this CD56-dim, CD57-bright cluster.
T-LGL cells may be CD57 positive and CD56 variable but express surface CD3, which must be excluded on other tubes.
Reactive NK cells show more heterogeneous CD57/CD56 and polyclonal KIR expression, with a transient course.
